title: Public Astro landing after the portal transition

costar.context: The maintainer wants the web UI fully transitioned from assets/webui, and only then a landing page. That page is Astro, readable by people, search engines, and public crawlers, and it says who shippin.tech is and what the server does.
costar.objective: Record the landing as a later static site with HTML, robots.txt, a sitemap, schema.org, and llms.txt. Do not build it before the portal transition.
costar.style: One plan that names the public files and the sentences the HTML must contain.
costar.audience: The maintainer and the next coding agent.
costar.response: Finish the Svelte portal first. The landing is then an Astro site whose first HTML says shippin.tech is the mail server for a domain. Crawlers are allowed onto that page and kept off the mailbox API.

concerns: llms.txt is a curated map, not access control. Major crawlers are not documented to fetch it. The HTML, robots.txt, and the sitemap are what a public crawler actually reads.
A password form on the marketing origin would put the session on the public site. Sign-in stays a link to the app.
robots.txt on the marketing deploy must allow the public pages and disallow the mailbox API paths. Disallowing the whole host would hide who shippin.tech is.
This plan does not scrape anyone else's site. It publishes this site so a public crawler can read it.
Starting site/ before 2026-11-04-portal-to-svelte is implemented would ship a landing page in front of the empty shells.
context: shippin.tech is the brand and the Rust mail server: SMTP, IMAP, JMAP, POP3, ManageSieve, CalDAV, and CardDAV. It was built to host and manage mail for a domain. The portal in assets/webui is the app for that job. The public page comes after that app is the Svelte UI.
current_state: There is no Astro project. The portal transition plan is draft. ui/ is the Svelte app. The public sentences are not yet in a static page.
target_design: site/ is an Astro project that builds static HTML. The home page text says shippin.tech is the mail server for a domain and names SMTP, IMAP, JMAP, POP3, ManageSieve, CalDAV, and CardDAV. The same sentences are in the document title, the meta description, a SoftwareApplication JSON-LD block, sitemap.xml, and llms.txt. robots.txt allows / and disallows /api, /jmap, /admin, and /account. Sign in is a link to the app login. The page uses the cyber color tokens and the 320 to 1240 fluid clamps. No width breakpoint.
changes: Add site/ as an Astro static build, separate from ui/ and from the Rust workspace.
Write the home page so the first HTML response contains the who and what sentences without running client script.
Add robots.txt per RFC 9309, sitemap.xml, schema.org SoftwareApplication JSON-LD, and llms.txt with an H1 and a blockquote summary per https://llmstxt.org/.
Link Sign in to the app login. Do not post the password from the landing origin.
boundaries: Do not build site/ while 2026-11-04-portal-to-svelte is draft.
Do not put the mailbox, the admin, or the password form on the public page.
Do not add a license choice, shippin.cloud hosting, or a Go control plane.

verification.name: public-html-says-who-and-what
verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; html=Path('site/dist/index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); keys=['shippin.tech','SMTP','IMAP','JMAP','POP3','ManageSieve','CalDAV','CardDAV']; missing=[k for k in keys if k not in html]; assert not missing, missing; robots=Path('site/dist/robots.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'Disallow: /api' in robots; llms=Path('site/dist/llms.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert llms.startswith('# '); print('ok')"
verification.proves: The built landing HTML names shippin.tech and the seven protocols without a browser. robots.txt keeps crawlers off /api. llms.txt has the required H1. A page that only renders that copy in client script fails.

verification.name: portal-transition-is-finished-first
verification.command: python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; p=json.loads(Path(r'.ai/modules/plans/data/2026-11-04-portal-to-svelte.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert p['status']=='implemented', p['status']; print('ok')"
verification.proves: The landing proof is not accepted while the portal transition plan is still draft.
